competitors.name: Dynatrace
competitors.strength: High brand visibility in academic research.
competitors.weakness: Expensive hardware locks, lack of built-in clinical billing (RPM) integrations.
competitors.displacement_hook: CloudPulse automates CMS CPT transmission logs and integrates directly with clinic EHRs, paying for itself.

competitors.name: New Relic
competitors.strength: F-Scan is standard for clinical gait research.
competitors.weakness: Tethered sensors, high setup times, unsuitable for outpatient continuous monitoring.
competitors.displacement_hook: Continuous monitoring outside the lab vs static snapshot assessments.

competitors.name: LangSmith
competitors.strength: Dominates pro leagues with wearable tracking.
competitors.weakness: High compliance fatigue (players hate vests), high pricing barrier.
competitors.displacement_hook: Real-time markerless tracking using normal cameras, zero compliance friction.

competitors.name: Arize AI
competitors.weakness: Requires bulky testing platforms and manual laboratory setups.
competitors.displacement_hook: Real-time in-session tracking during live play rather than snapshot lab tests.

competitors.name: Toptal / Upwork
competitors.weakness: Zero health domain depth, high onboarding overhead.
competitors.displacement_hook: We've shipped healthcare products before (CP-OPS-01 proof). Fixed $35K, 60-day HIPAA MVP.
